design_flaws.flaw: The mechanical enemy-event transform crashes the host when the host body is gone. Replacing instance_exists(objPlayer) with instance_exists(coop_t) while leaving other objPlayer.<field> reads in place lets the code continue to unguarded host-body reads once coop_t is the puppet. Concrete case: gml_Object_objSwat_Step_0.gml:108-116 becomes `if (!instance_exists(coop_t)) {...exit} else if (scrIsAttacking(objPlayer.sprite_index))` followed by place_meeting(...objPlayer.dir...). The same pattern is in objPanther_Step_0.gml:5 then :124 and objECrawl_Step_0.gml:61 then :69,:86-113. Of the 67 enemy-family entries with objPlayer.x/y, 31 also read other objPlayer fields or use with/place_meeting. With DisplayErrors/VariableErrors on, 'Unable to find any instance for object index 98' triggers as soon as the host dies near such an enemy. objSwat_Step_0 and objPanther_Step_0 are named explicitly in the patch list.
design_flaws.fix: Never rewrite a guard unless every objPlayer reference it protects is rewritten too. Make the transform AST- or line-aware: rewrite whole guarded blocks to coop_t, or keep the original guard and add a separate puppet branch. Alternatively make scrCoopTarget return objPlayer whenever any host objPlayer exists, and treat the puppet only through explicitly ported code. Re-decompile and diff, and fuzz the 'host dead, client alive' state in M2.

design_flaws.flaw: Running scrPlayerIsAttacking in the puppet's scope on the host can destroy the host's body. Execution branches do instance_create of objBikerKillFat / objPKillChainsawFat / objPKillDog (objPlayer children that later recreate objPlayerMouse) followed by with(objPlayerBiker) or with(objPlayerMouse) instance_destroy() (scrPlayerIsAttacking.gml ~505-521, ~523-563, ~650-668). The plan only rewrites objPlayer.<var> and place_meeting(...,objPlayer). The script also writes host-player globals (global.bigballs, global.EnergieSkippyGun, global.dogsave, global.pigkill, global.usedkill) when the puppet attacks.
design_flaws.fix: In the parameterised copy, retarget every with(objPlayerMouse)/with(objPlayerBiker) to global.coop_att. When coop_att is the puppet, suppress execution-object creation and send an EXECUTE event so the client plays it on its own body. Swap or save-restore the per-player globals the script writes, not just maskindex/maskon/powerIgel/shake.

design_flaws.flaw: Enemy-side melee detection ignores the puppet. objSwat_Step_0:114-118, objPanther_Step_0:124-185, objWaiter_Step_0:42-44, objECrawl_Step_0:100-113 and objKnockedOut_Step_0:9 decide being hit by reading objPlayer.sprite_index plus place_meeting(objPlayer). The client's melee therefore never knocks down SWAT, panthers, waiters or crawlers on the host, even with the parameterised scrPlayerIsAttacking.
design_flaws.fix: Add these sites to the attacker parameterisation: loop over {local body, puppet} or use global.coop_att set by the puppet's Step. Otherwise list them as unsupported for remote melee.

design_flaws.flaw: The melee armor path is executed on the wrong PC. When mask 21, biker armor or scrCheckMeleeEnergie absorbs a hit, scrPlayerDieMelee.gml:402-451 and scrPlayerDieDogBite.gml:36-52 convert the ATTACKER into objKnockedOut/objFatKnockedOut and instance_destroy it. Run on the client against an objCoopEnt, this creates a host-owned class (removed by the sanitizer), destroys the puppet (the next ENT resurrects it), and sets `type` to objCoopEnt's index. The host enemy stays standing and in contact. The host also unconditionally destroys the dog after the call (objDogPatrol_Step_0.gml:69). pending_death_life has no resolution path, so the client ends up either permanently melee-immune or killed on the next contact frame. The M3 'Walrus absorbs first hit' test cannot pass. The script's early exit for unarmed killers (scrPlayerDieMelee.gml:6-9) leaves the same pending state.
design_flaws.fix: Use two phases. The host sends MELEE_HIT and the client evaluates armor and replies DIED or ABSORBED(+knockback dir). On ABSORBED the host runs the knockback branch on the real enemy, and on DIED it clears pending. Add a pending timeout of about RTT plus 250 ms. Give objCoopEnt the ammo/hits variables the death scripts read.

design_flaws.flaw: The host-dead case deadlocks floor and level completion. Every completion and unlock path on the host is gated on the host's own body: objTransitioner_Step_0.gml:6 exits when no objPlayer, freezing solid/visible; STAGE CLEAR runs inside the host body's Step (objPlayerMouse_Step_0.gml:224-262); scrCheckMissionComplete.gml:1 needs instance_exists(objPlayer); objTransitioner_Collision_98.gml:5 exits when solid==1. If the host dies and the client clears the floor, FLOOR_CLEAR is never sent, the client's mirrored exits stay locked, REQ_EXIT's 'unlocked' check fails, global.done never becomes 1, and the car is host-only. The stated rule 'the dead player respawns when the partner takes the stairs' works only when the CLIENT is the dead one. When the host is mid-execution, Collision_98:9 also rejects execution objects, so REQ_EXIT silently fails.
design_flaws.fix: Compute floor-clear and mission-complete in objCoopNet on the host from instance counts, independent of the host body (port the objTransitioner_Step_0:22 and scrCheckMissionComplete conditions). Unlock exits from that, and let REQ_EXIT and the car trigger (forwarded from the client) work while the host is dead or busy.

design_flaws.flaw: The client world has no objEnemy, but 43 files gate behaviour on local enemy existence and the design patches about 5. Unpatched examples: objDoorDoneH_Step_0.gml:1-8 (enemy-locked doors are open on the client), objTrainTransition_Step_0.gml:18 (the train-arrival sequence starts at once on the client), objTrain_Step_0.gml:18, objTeleporter_Step_0.gml:18, objElevator_Step_0.gml:22/76, objPhone_Draw_0.gml:23, objPlayerMouse_Other_4.gml:1-8 (clear flag), STAGE CLEAR in objPlayerBiker/objPlayerGriffin/objPigButcher Steps, scrCheckpoint.gml:1, objCellDoor_Mouse_53. The restart branch also depends on this: objEffector_Step_0.gml:450 checks objTrain.visible (local train sim), and :519 checks global.done (10 Hz HUD mirror). Host and client can then take different restart branches (checkpoint vs full reset).
design_flaws.fix: Audit all 43 sites. On the client, replace local counts with a replicated value (e.g. scrCoopEnemyExists() fed by HUD/ENT counts per class). Make RESTART carry the host's branch selector, and have the client force that branch.

design_flaws.flaw: Doors opened by enemies are never mirrored. objCoopEnt has no collision, so doors that host enemies push stay shut on the client. The client's line of sight differs, its bullets stop locally at a door that is open on the host (the enemy still dies there), and ghost objEBullets stop at a door the host bullet passed. Door drift is listed as a risk, but this is systematic, because enemies walk through doors constantly.
design_flaws.fix: Replicate door state host to client (image_angle/swingspeed for changed doors, unreliable, about 10 Hz). Alternatively give objCoopEnt the same door-collision forwarder the puppet uses.

design_flaws.flaw: The kill switch breaks when the DLL is absent. The global_init patch sets only global.coop_dll=0, but patched entries read global.coop_role, global.coop_src, global.coop_victim and global.coop_att directly (e.g. `if (global.coop_role == 2 && scrCoopActive())`). With VariableErrors set, the first patched event crashes. The M0 'DLL deleted plays identically' test fails.
design_flaws.fix: Initialise every coop global (coop_active=0, coop_role=0, coop_src=objPlayer, coop_victim=objPlayer, coop_att=noone, coop_lastid=0, …) unconditionally in global_init, before the file_exists check.

design_flaws.flaw: Teardown on Game End may kill the session on every host game_restart. objCoopNet's Game End sends BYE, coop_disconnect and coop_shutdown. game_restart runs on the host during normal progression: objEffector_Step_0.gml:387 (restart==1, set by scrCarNextRoom), :400 (sequence 39/41), objMaskUnlock_Draw_0.gml:175, objPause_Draw_0.gml:86, objOptions_KeyPress_13.gml:159, objBikeEnding/objDizzy/objEffectorHouse Draw. If this runner fires Game End on game_restart (unverified), the 'idempotent coop_init survives game_restart' plan is defeated, and the client drops at every chapter boundary.
design_flaws.fix: Probe in M0 whether Other_3 fires on game_restart. Only call coop_shutdown when a global quitting flag is set, at the 3 game_end sites and on window close. Otherwise let the DLL session persist and re-attach in scrCoopInit. Guard against duplicate objCoopNet.

design_flaws.flaw: The patch target name for the focus throttle is wrong. gml_Object_objconsole_Step_0 (code index 5500) is an orphan. The bound objConsole Step is gml_Object_objConsole_Step_0 (index 5591; see scratchpad modmap/event_bindings.tsv and orphans.tsv). A name-based UTMT patch edits dead code, and room_speed=30 survives.
design_flaws.fix: Patch by object and event binding (objConsole idx 1140, Step_0), not by file name. Assert that the patched entry contains `room_speed = 30`.

design_flaws.flaw: NEXT does not replicate the per-player save snapshot. objTransitioner_Collision_98.gml:22-44 saves shells, knives, meleeenergie, bigballs, dogsave, BuffSkippy and the score *save globals, and also sets global.overright (11-14). scrCoopApplyNext copies only 5 values, so client restarts (objEffector_Step_0.gml:548-566) restore knives/armor/BuffSkippy from level start (PauseRestart reset at :331-342). code5320:3 restores global.shells from a stale shellssave, and overright-dependent spawns (code5320:8-18) are wrong.
design_flaws.fix: In scrCoopApplyNext, execute the full save block (lines 22-44 plus the mask 13 hard-mode clause) and the overright rule using the toucher position.

design_flaws.flaw: A dead player who leaves a floor via NEXT leaves objPlayerDead in that persistent room. On revisit, objPlayerDead_Step_0.gml:288-313 lerps view_xview/yview every frame against the live camera, and 17 files react to instance_exists(objPlayerDead): the scrDrawHUD restart prompt, scrScreenFilterEffector, objBackgroundColor_Draw_0. Respawn also depends on a placed objPlayerMouse that code5320 already destroyed on earlier visits.
design_flaws.fix: Destroy the local objPlayerDead in scrCoopApplyNext. After arriving through NEXT with no objPlayer present, instance_create objPlayerMouse at the floor's start (or the toucher position) with the saved loadout.

design_flaws.flaw: One enemy bullet can kill both players. On the host, objEBullet passes through the puppet and keeps flying, while on the client its ghost kills the client and is destroyed. The same bullet can then kill the host standing behind the partner.
design_flaws.fix: Tag replicated bullets with their host nid. The client sends BULLET_HIT(nid) on a victim-side death and the host destroys that bullet, accepting a small window.

design_flaws.flaw: ENet packet sizing. coop_flush targets 1200-byte packets with MTU 1200, but ENet adds protocol and command headers, so full-size unreliable packets fragment. In ENet 1.3.x, fragmented unreliable packets are sent reliably unless ENET_PACKET_FLAG_UNRELIABLE_FRAGMENT is set, which brings back head-of-line blocking for ENT/PSTATE.
design_flaws.fix: Cap coalesced payloads at about MTU-64 (about 1130 B) and set UNRELIABLE_FRAGMENT for channel 1 sends. Log fragment counts via coop_stat.

design_flaws.flaw: Identity and epoch gaps. It is unclear whether the client increments its own epoch at Room Start, but READY and the dead-nid sets must use the host's epoch. PICKUP_REQ, THROW_REQ and REQ_EXIT carry no epoch, and the rmTrainstationEntrance/rmSwatDownstairs restarts keep persistent ids, so stale requests can delete or move objects in the new attempt. 'Net objWeapon vanished locally = pickup' also misfires: objEffector_Other_4.gml:14-22 (mask 22 turns objWeapon into gas canisters) and scrCleanItems on restart both destroy net weapons locally, which then deletes them on the host.
design_flaws.fix: Make the epoch host-assigned only, and stamp every client-to-host request with (room, epoch). Detect pickups by hooking scrPlayerPickUp's destroy of a net weapon (set a flag before instance_destroy), not by polling for disappearance.

design_flaws.flaw: Remote melee timing depends on snapped, unreliable PSTATE sprites. Lost or jitter-coalesced packets skip attack frames (latest-wins per host frame), and the puppet's 0.5 smoothing puts the 12 px probe behind the true position. Swings that look solid on the client miss on the host.
design_flaws.fix: Send a reliable MELEE_START (sprite, dir, x, y, sender frame) and run the attack window on the host for the sprite's frame range, anchored at the reported position.

design_flaws.flaw: The client menu lock is incomplete. Only objTitleNew_KeyPress_13 and objLevelSelectNew_Mouse_53 are gated, but objTitleNew also has Mouse_53/KeyPress_32, objLevelSelectNew has KeyPress_13/32, and the legacy objTitle/objLevelSelect menus exist (chosen by ini level_select_new, objSplashScreen_Create_0.gml:45).
design_flaws.fix: Gate all start events of all four menu objects, or have objCoopNet park the client in a dedicated lobby room.

design_flaws.flaw: Barrier side effects. objEffector.amount ramps back up by +5 every frame when fade==0 (objEffector_Step_0.gml:350-355), so blackout must be re-applied each frame. global.player_lock is also used by scripts (objJonesBoss_Create), so a blind reset on release can unlock a scripted freeze.
design_flaws.fix: Hold amount every frame. Save and restore player_lock/notarget instead of forcing 0.

design_flaws.flaw: Cosmetic and per-player mismatches. objBullet/objEBullet Create set sprite_index=global.sprite_bullet (the receiver's) and global.noguns=0, and FIRE does not carry the sprite. objCoopEnt mode 1 hard-codes sprELegs. Dennis knives on the client are objCoopEnt, so objDennisThrowingKnife_Collision_98 (speed<=0 gives global.knives+=1) cannot return them to the thrower, and the host's body collects the client's knives. Client-side box, gift and trunk weapons (scrPlayerPickUp.gml:332,368) are host-owned classes with no forward message, so the sanitizer silently deletes them.
design_flaws.fix: Add sprite and leg-sprite fields. Make knife retrieval owner-aware (PICKUP_REQ for knives). Add a SPAWN_REQ for client-created ground weapons, or keep those interactables host-only explicitly.

design_flaws.flaw: Unverified UTMT bytecode-15 caveats. The only recompile probe added 0 FUNC entries. New scripts need SCPT, CODE and FUNC entries, and objects must exist before compiling code that names them. Recompiling decompiled entries with GMS1 backslash literals (e.g. objEffector_Step_0 `working_directory + "\restartmusic"`, and the new `"\SuperRRCoop.dll"`) needs a check that UTMT does no escape processing for GMS1. The runner has event_perform_object, instance_activate_object and buffer_* natively, so a successful FUNC-append probe would open simpler options.
design_flaws.fix: Add M0 round-trip probes: compile a script calling window_set_caption and event_perform_object, and recompile one entry containing backslash strings. Diff the re-decompiled bytecode for both.

missing: Host dies but the client is alive: floor-clear, exit unlock, global.done, the car and LEVEL_END all need the host body (objTransitioner_Step_0:6, objPlayerMouse_Step_0:224-262, scrCheckMissionComplete:1)

Client-side replacement for the 43 local enemy-count gates: objDoorDoneH, objTrainTransition, objTrain, objTeleporter_Step, objElevator, objPhone, other bodies' STAGE CLEAR, scrCheckpoint, restart branch selection
Door state driven by host enemies; the client never sees enemy-opened doors

Execution branches inside scrPlayerIsAttacking (objBikerKillFat / objPKillChainsawFat / objPKillDog) and enemy-side hit detection reading objPlayer.sprite_index (objSwat, objPanther, objWaiter, objECrawl, objKnockedOut)
Two-phase melee resolution for the armor and mask-21 absorb path, where the attacker is knocked out, and a timeout for pending_death_life
